# Version 4.152.2
> **GPU failure handling** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.202/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.2 improves Ganesh upload and flush failure handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim compatibility** — The bundled libHarfBuzzSharp.dll now passes BA2007 by scoping truncation-warning suppression to vendored source. Existing unrelated BinSkim warnings are unchanged. ([#5121](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5121))
- **GPU buffer upload failures** — Ganesh rejects incomplete buffers and drops affected draws when GPU uploads fail under memory pressure, rather than drawing stale contents. Triangulated paths retain CPU vertex data for a later upload attempt. ([#5117](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5117))
- **Ganesh flush failure propagation** — Separates task execution from success and propagates task, flush, and submission failures internally. Existing managed flush methods remain void; this update does not expose a new status result. ([#5069](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5069))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.202

The bundled Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 through source-scoped warning suppression. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged; unrelated pre-existing BinSkim warnings remain.
